description: "The Complete Poetical Works of Henry Wadsworth Longfellow" by Longfellow is a comprehensive collection of poetry likely compiled in the early 20th century.
longDescription: This extensive volume encompasses all of Longfellow's original verses along with his translations, showcasing his dedication to capturing the essence of human experience, nature, and the profound emotions tied to life and history through various themes and forms of verse.

authorInfo.bio: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow (1807–1882) wrote The Song of Hiawatha: An Epic Poem. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
